Trump claims Reflecting Pool work complete amid ongoing repairs

President Donald Trump has stated that work on the Reflecting Pool is complete, despite ongoing repairs and workers present at the site. He attributed damage to the pool to vandals and announced that it would be refilled this week. Amid the controversy, a former Olympic canoeist was arrested.
